result.abstract: The Victorian Integrated Survey of Travel and Activity (VISTA) is an ongoing survey of household travel activity.
result.author: Department of Transport and Planning
result.name: victorian-integrated-survey-of-travel-and-activity-vista
result.notes:
The Victorian Integrated Survey of Travel and Activity is a major data collection exercise conducted by DTP to understand all aspects of day\-to\-day travel by Victorians. VISTA is a rich dataset that investigates travel and activities people undertake as they go about their lives and informs policy, project and planning decisions made across the Victorian transport portfolio. 

  


Since 2012, more than 32,000 households have contributed to the ongoing survey. Data collection is spread evenly across each year, allowing average daily travel behaviours to be described. See the [VISTA website](https://www.vic.gov.au/victorian-integrated-survey-travel-and-activity) for more details about this survey.

  


Detailed findings are available via an [interactive data visualisation tool](https://public.tableau.com/app/profile/vista/vizzes) that allows users to explore the data further.
